$comment: Every file SDGA publishes at figma.com/@sdga, classified by what it contributes to the ledger. /dga-sync reads this to know what is still missing and what each file would close. The MCP reads one focused file at a time, so a full sync is several passes — this manifest is what makes that resumable instead of a thing you have to remember.
publisher: DGA / SDGA — هيئة الحكومة الرقمية, Kingdom of Saudi Arabia

$tiers.system: The design system itself. The ledger is wrong or incomplete without these.
$tiers.template: Reference page implementations. Not token sources — they define page-level patterns, and are what P1–P3 compare a real page against.
$tiers.campaign: Seasonal and identity artwork. Not standards. Deliberately excluded — syncing these would pollute the palette with campaign colours.

sources.name: Foundations - Platforms Code
sources.why: The actual foundations file. The Components Library has no foundations page — its tokens are only what happens to be bound to components — so this is the authoritative source and should have been synced first. Expected to supply the breakpoint grid, border widths, the full elevation set, motion tokens, the missing spacing-sm, the Display lg/md ramp steps, and a dark mode set if one exists.

sources.name: Components Library - Platforms Code
sources.why: 48 component pages. Synced: 147 colour tokens, 8 type steps, the spacing and radius scales, and anatomy for Button, Text input, Card and Inline alert. Only 4 of 48 component pages are recorded — extend as audits meet components not covered.

sources.name: Icons - Platforms Code
sources.why: The official icon set. Supplies the size scale, stroke weight, and the icon inventory itself — without it I1 degrades to 'does this look like one family', which is the weakest check in the rubric.
sources.deferredReason: Skipped on request, 17 Aug 2026. While deferred, I1 (icon set) is scored n/a rather than judged — a check whose baseline was deliberately not loaded should leave the denominator, not be guessed at. Sync this file to bring I1 back.

sources.name: Mobile Components - Platforms Code
sources.why: Mobile component anatomy. Every site audit captures at a 375px viewport, and right now those captures are scored against desktop component specs — so mobile target sizes and padding are being judged by the wrong ruler.

sources.name: Home Page Template - Platforms Code
sources.why: The most-used template on the profile (4.8k). Defines the section order and hero/nav/footer composition a government home page is expected to follow.

sources.name: Service Page Template - Platforms Code
sources.why: The page type a government platform has most of. Service detail, eligibility, steps, apply.

sources.name: Form Template - Platforms Code
sources.why: Forms carry the heaviest accessibility burden on any gov service — label placement, error summary, required marking, fieldset grouping.
